summary: Frontend-only regression test of the GPS location bug fix on Home dashboard. Verified via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) against the public preview URL with grant_permissions + set_geolocation. RESULT: BUG FIX VERIFIED. When geolocation is granted (Mumbai 19.0760, 72.8777), both testID='home-location-text' AND the weather card show 'Mumbai, Maharashtra' — no longer the hardcoded 'Nashik, Maharashtra'. Reverse geocoding via Nominatim works on web. When permission is denied, text correctly displays 'Tap to enable GPS' and testID='home-location-button' is tappable. No 'useDeviceLocation is not defined' runtime error. Filled 'location' icon appears in primary green when granted (visually confirmed in screenshot). One minor caching issue found: getWebLocation uses maximumAge:60000, so a re-tap of the location button within 60s returns the previous cached coordinates instead of the newly-set coordinates — the location does not refresh until cache expires.

integration_issues.flow: GPS re-request (loc.request) on web after grant
integration_issues.issue: useDeviceLocation.getWebLocation() passes maximumAge:60000 to navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition. After first successful fetch, tapping the location button within 60s returns the cached position rather than fetching fresh coords. Repro: grant permissions, load home, tap home-location-button → coords do not refresh even if underlying geolocation changed. Fix: set maximumAge to 0 (or a small value like 5000) in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceLocation.ts:26 so an explicit user-triggered request always gets a fresh reading.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears across many screens (likely from Shadow theme in /app/frontend/src/theme). Not related to GPS bug but worth cleaning up.
Console warns: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Migrate style.resizeMode to props.resizeMode across the app.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — some component still uses prop form.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceLocation.ts change maximumAge from 60000 to 0 so that user-triggered loc.request() on web always fetches fresh coords (currently cache prevents re-request from updating within 60s).
OPTIONAL: Fix RN web deprecation warnings — migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (theme), style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode on Images, and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed on web preview. Login flow: navigate to /login route (skip onboarding by clicking Skip if seen), then click testID='login-submit-button' — email/password are pre-filled with demo@cropido.app/demo1234. To test geolocation on web, use context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=<URL>) BEFORE goto, then context.set_geolocation({latitude, longitude}). Note: navigator.geolocation cache (maximumAge:60000) causes re-tap of location button within 60s to return same coords.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Location was hardcoded as Nashik, Maharashtra on Home dashboard'. Fix implemented in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceLocation.ts (new hook) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx (uses hook + reverse geocoding via expo-location on native, Nominatim on web). Verification: Playwright set geolocation to Mumbai (19.0760, 72.8777); Home header rendered 'Mumbai, Maharashtra' and weather card also showed 'Mumbai, Maharashtra'. Denied path rendered 'Tap to enable GPS'.
